ResearchProjectDef.label: security clearance brain interface
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture a set of nanoelectrodes and antennas which can be used by any sentient biological being to open clearance-locked doors remotely. Clearance level is programmed onto the set during installation, and cannot be changed until it is removed.
For humanlike pawns with natural arms, a hand-implanted version can be used instead.

ResearchProjectDef.label: programmable security clearance microchip
ResearchProjectDef.description:
Manufacture a hand-implantable microchip that can act as a security keycard. Clearance level is programmed onto the chip during installation, and cannot be changed until it is removed.
Pawns with bionic arms and animals can use the brain interface version instead.
